title: Reject extraneous SCHC descriptor metadata for cross-implementation parity
description: Correctness review found Rust accepts mo_arg metadata when neither MO=MSB nor CDA=LSB and mapping metadata when neither MO=MatchMapping nor CDA=MappingSent, while Python rejects those malformed descriptors. Enforce canonical metadata presence: mo_arg iff the supported MSB/LSB pair needs it, mapping iff the supported MatchMapping/MappingSent pair needs it. Add a cross-implementation descriptor acceptance matrix and ensure built-in rules remain valid.
